narrative: The coffer open, two locks turned back, a ruled leaf, the belt beside it and not yet emptied onto the page. No face. The same leaf. The belt's coins have gone into the coffer. A second pair of lines, ruled off. The belt is shut beside the box.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Counted once, moved the seven shillings, and ruled it off.

entities.name: twenty pound fifteen shillings
entities.context: Shown on ledger in Twenty pound fifteen
